title: 第560章 沈浪上演苦肉计李青幽懵圈了第559章 一石三鸟精妙绝伦
slug: 提蓝桥刚毕业女帝求我当宰相
content_zh:
正所谓，会说话的人，总能赢得他人的关注。
九千岁这番看似关心的话语，却深深地抓住了李青幽的好奇心。
毕竟，在大周仙朝内的小媳妇，谁人不知王莽的特殊癖好？
所以，在李青幽看来，王莽既然提出来让自己去陪他，来换取崔勇的狗命，现在显然是急不可耐的在等自己才对！
可看九千岁这意思，现在发生了一件，比起王莽见她还要重要的事情。
这使得李青幽对于这件事到底是什么，很好奇！
但奈何自己现在都是泥菩萨过江自身难保。
李青幽虽然心底打着无数的问号，也不好意思追问。
只能默默点头，顺从九千岁的意思！
九千岁眼见计划成功，也是立刻按照刚刚与沈浪在等待时，密谋的操作，召唤来了一架由灵鹤拉动的轿子，笑着眯起眼道：“你先上轿吧！”
“好！”
李青幽没有迟疑，抱着妞妞便掀开了悬挂在轿门上的帘子。
然而。
帘子内的景象却看得李青幽有些愣神。
因为，此刻的帘子内，并非是空无一人。
还有个被五花大绑的年轻人，正用一种看淡世间一切的眼神，看着她。
那帅气的面容，那宛若星辰一般，充满智慧的眼眸，看得李青幽一时间都忘记了自己身处在何地。
最后还是九千岁在她的身后，幽幽地提了句：“进去吧！”
“好！”
李青幽反应了过来，赶忙进入了轿子内，而后坐在了沈浪的对面。

随后九千岁也坐了进来，挥动了下手臂，他的轿子，便被仙鹤拉上了天空！
或许是轿子内的气氛太压抑了！
又或许妞妞从未见过被五花大绑的人！
此刻，就在轿子在空中不急不缓的飞行时，妞妞忍不住的开口发问：
“娘亲，这人就是您常说的坏人吗？！他是犯了什么罪呀？！”
妞妞这话问出。
李青幽脸色瞬间大变。
她很清楚，能被九千岁亲自看押的人，绝对不是善类。
妞妞这个时候，突然间问出这样的问题，无异于是触碰雷区。
不想妞妞因此出现什么意外的她，赶忙出言训斥道：
“胡说什么，不准说话，闭上眼睛睡觉！”
content_en:
As the saying goes, people who can talk can always win the attention of others.
Jiu Qiansui's seemingly caring words deeply captured Li Qingyou's curiosity.
After all, among the young wives in the Great Zhou Immortal Dynasty, who doesn’t know Wang Mang’s special hobbies?
Therefore, in Li Qingyou's view, since Wang Mang offered to let him accompany him in exchange for Cui Yong's life, he is obviously waiting impatiently for him!
But judging from the meaning of Jiu Qiansui, something more important than Wang Mang seeing her happened now.
This made Li Qingyou very curious about what this matter was!
But no matter what, I am now a clay Buddha and cannot protect myself when crossing the river.
Although Li Qingyou had countless questions in his heart, he was too embarrassed to ask.
I can only nod silently and obey the wishes of Nine Thousand Years Old!
Seeing that the plan was successful, Jiu Qiansui immediately summoned a sedan chair pulled by a spiritual crane according to the operation he had just planned while waiting with Shen Lang. He smiled and narrowed his eyes and said: "Get in the sedan chair first!"
"Okay!"
Li Qingyou didn't hesitate, hugged Niu Niu and opened the curtain hanging on the sedan door.
However.
The scene inside the curtain made Li Qingyou a little stunned.
Because, the curtain at this moment was not empty.
There was also a young man who was tied up and looking at her with a look that looked down upon everything in the world.
That handsome face, those eyes that were like stars, full of wisdom, made Li Qingyou forget where he was for a moment.
In the end, Jiu Qiansui was behind her and said faintly: "Go in!"
"Okay!"
Li Qingyou reacted, quickly entered the sedan, and then sat opposite Shen Lang.
Then Jiu Qiansui also sat in, waved his arms, and his sedan chair was pulled up into the sky by the crane!
Maybe the atmosphere inside the sedan was too depressing!
Or maybe Niuniu has never seen a person tied up with five flowers!
At this moment, while the sedan was flying leisurely in the air, Niu Niu couldn't help but ask:
"Mom, is this person the bad guy you often say?! What crime has he committed?!"
Niuniu asked this.
Li Qingyou's expression changed instantly.
She knew very well that anyone who could be personally guarded by Jiu Qiansui was definitely not a kind person.
At this time, Niu Niu suddenly asked such a question, which was tantamount to touching a minefield.
Not wanting anything to happen to Niuniu, she hurriedly reprimanded:
"What nonsense are you talking about? Don't talk. Close your eyes and sleep!"
